## Why this study was run

**Research question:** [Can candidate-side semantic evidence improve query-only retrieval?](../questions/candidate-evidence.qmd)

Test profile summaries at multiple semantic resolutions.

**Rationale:** The tracked amendment and issue-18 evaluation define the variants.

## Protocol and comparison

**Hypothesis:** Combining broad and focused profile evidence improves on the promoted equal-weight fusion.

Construct six frozen multiresolution variants and evaluate them on the full development scope.

Any run comparison below is partitioned by ledger evaluation scope.

## Current result

**Outcome:** `mixed`

Several variants are strong development diagnostics, but none displaced the promoted decision.

## Decision and rationale

**Decision:** `retain_control`

Retain the promoted semantic-profile system; keep multiresolution variants diagnostic.

Rationale provenance: `contemporaneous`.

## Evidence limits

Development diagnostics with missing construction artifacts; no hidden-test evidence.

Development results do not establish hidden-test effectiveness.
